name: forgeplan-workflow
description: Structured engineering workflow for forgeplan users: `/forge-cycle` drives one artifact through the full pipeline to activation with the quality gates enforced at each stage, and `/forge-audit` reviews what came out. Use when a piece of work is Standard depth or above and should not reach activation without evidence, a review and a gate — the cycle refuses to advance rather than letting a stage be skipped quietly. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.
